name: eva-studio
description: Manage digital signage screens, drafts, media and designs in your connected EVA workspace.

interface.longDescription: Connect your EVA account to view company screens and drafts, inspect designs, organize media and make requested changes. Edit text, layout and media in screen drafts, then publish or schedule content when you request it. Access is limited to the connected company, granted OAuth permissions and enabled EVA plan features. Write and publication tools execute directly within those permissions; there is no separate EVA approval page. An EVA account and applicable plan features are required.
defaultPrompt: Show the design of my selected EVA screen.

positive.expected_behavior: Return only screens in the OAuth-connected review company; do not change them.
Return accessible named and screen drafts without changing them.

positive.prompt: Read the saved draft named İnceleme Testi.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the sample draft ID, read it with kind saved, and show its preview without publication.

positive.prompt: Show the design of the screen named test.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the sample screen ID and return its design and current versions without changing it.

positive.description: Update the designated saved test draft
positive.prompt: Read the saved draft İnceleme Testi. Change its headline to EVA Studio testi başarılı and save the existing draft using its current revision. Do not publish.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current saved draft and revision, update only its headline using eva_update_named_draft, and verify the saved text and new revision. Do not create a duplicate draft or publish to any screen.

negative.prompt: Read a draft from a company outside my connected EVA account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose data from another company. If an inaccessible fixture ID is tested, the server must reject it.

negative.prompt: With my read-only EVA connection, rename the screen named test.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the write or explain that additional OAuth permission is required. Do not change the screen.

negative.prompt: With my EVA connection that lacks publishing permission, publish İnceleme Testi to the screen named test.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not publish. Server must enforce eva:publish and direct execution consent rather than trusting the prompt.

publication.release_notes: Initial public EVA Studio package. Inspect company screens and drafts, update existing saved drafts with version checks, and edit designs with individually exposed tools. Publish content only when requested and authorized. File import tools declare external access.
